fields.description: Prefix used to auto-generate the unique job number for this service job.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: The originating customer service request this job was created to fulfil.
fields.label: Service Request

fields.description: Internal key that prevents the same service request from spawning duplicate jobs.
fields.label: Request Idempotency Key

fields.description: Internal key that guards a single request operation against duplicate processing.
fields.label: Request Operation Key

fields.description: Internal key that guards against duplicate jobs released from a maintenance schedule.
fields.label: Maintenance Release Key

fields.description: The customer who owns the equipment or site being serviced and will be billed.
fields.label: Customer

fields.description: The customer's display name, fetched automatically from the customer record.
fields.label: Customer Name

fields.description: The person to reach on site or by phone for coordinating this job.
fields.label: Contact

fields.description: The operating company responsible for delivering and invoicing this job.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: The project this job is booked against for tracking and cost roll-up.
fields.label: Project

fields.description: Current lifecycle stage of the job, from Draft through Completed or Cancelled.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Planned
Scheduled
Dispatched
In Progress
On Hold
Completed
Cancelled

fields.description: The active field-execution stage the job is in, such as Travel, Inspection, or On-Site Service.
fields.label: Phase
fields.options:
Planning
Travel
Check-In
Inspection
Diagnosis
On-Site Service
Workshop
Testing
Customer Verification
Closeout

fields.description: Why the job is paused when it is placed On Hold, such as awaiting parts or approval.
fields.label: Hold Reason
fields.options:
Customer
Material
Approval
Access
Weather
Workshop
Other

fields.description: The status the job will return to once the hold is lifted.
fields.label: Hold From Status

fields.description: Urgency level that drives scheduling and dispatch order for this job.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: The category of work being performed, such as installation, repair, or preventive maintenance.
fields.label: Service Type

fields.description: Planned date and time the technician should begin work on site.
fields.label: Scheduled Start

fields.description: Planned date and time the job is expected to be finished.
fields.label: Scheduled End

fields.description: SLA deadline by which a technician must respond to or start this job.
fields.label: Promised Response By

fields.description: Actual date and time the job first received a technician response.
fields.label: Responded On

fields.description: Geographic service territory this job falls under, used for routing and reporting.
fields.label: Service Territory

fields.description: The crew assigned to carry out this job.
fields.label: Assigned Service Team

fields.description: Lead technician of the assigned team, fetched from the team record.
fields.label: Team Leader

fields.description: The technician primarily accountable for completing this job.
fields.label: Primary Technician

fields.description: Set automatically when the promised response time passes without a response.
fields.label: SLA Breached

fields.description: The address record where the service is to be performed.
fields.label: Service Address

fields.description: Formatted, read-only view of the full service address.
fields.label: Address

fields.description: Geocoded job-site latitude used by dispatch to find the nearest technician.
fields.label: Service Latitude

fields.description: Geocoded job-site longitude used by dispatch to find the nearest technician.
fields.label: Service Longitude

fields.description: The predefined checklist template applied to generate the job's tasks.
fields.label: Checklist Template

fields.description: The list of work steps or checklist items the technician must complete on this job.
fields.label: Tasks

fields.description: The customer assets or installed equipment serviced during this job.
fields.label: Installed Equipment

fields.description: The parts consumed and services rendered on this job, with quantities and rates.
fields.label: Items

fields.description: Total billable value of all parts and services on the job.
fields.label: Total Amount

fields.description: The service contract that may cover this job under warranty or a maintenance plan.
fields.label: Service Contract

fields.description: How this job is covered financially, such as under warranty, contract, or chargeable.
fields.label: Coverage Status
fields.options:
Warranty
Contract Covered
Partially Covered
Chargeable
FOC
Not Covered

fields.description: Explanation of why the determined coverage status applies.
fields.label: Coverage Reason

fields.description: Indicates the labour on this job is covered by warranty or contract.
fields.label: Labour Covered

fields.description: Indicates the parts on this job are covered by warranty or contract.
fields.label: Parts Covered

fields.description: Indicates the travel for this job is covered by warranty or contract.
fields.label: Travel Covered

fields.description: Date and time the job was marked complete.
fields.label: Completed On

fields.description: Customer's captured signature confirming the work was completed and accepted.
fields.label: Customer Signature

fields.description: The quotation raised for chargeable work on this job.
fields.label: Quotation

fields.description: The sales invoice generated to bill the customer for this job.
fields.label: Sales Invoice

fields.description: Estimated labour hours for the job, from the estimate engine or set manually.
fields.label: Estimated Hours

fields.description: Actual labour hours logged by technicians against this job.
fields.label: Actual Hours

fields.description: Charge-out or cost rate per labour hour used to value the work.
fields.label: Labour Rate (per hour)

fields.description: Calculated labour cost based on hours worked and the labour rate.
fields.label: Labour Cost

fields.description: Calculated cost of the parts and materials consumed on the job.
fields.label: Materials Cost

fields.description: Cost of technician travel to and from the job site.
fields.label: Travel Cost

fields.description: Allocated overhead applied to this job.
fields.label: Overhead Cost

fields.description: Total delivered cost of the job, summing labour, materials, travel, and overhead.
fields.label: Total Cost

fields.description: Free-form internal notes about the job's execution or special instructions.
fields.label: Notes
